role: Declares the break-speed and harvestability API of harvest.c and the harvest_player struct that carries the player's held item, Efficiency level, Haste and Mining Fatigue amplifiers, ground and water flags into one query.

structs.name: harvest_player
structs.java: the EntityPlayer state getCurrentPlayerStrVsBlock reads: inventory.getCurrentItem, EnchantmentHelper.getEfficiencyModifier, the digSpeed and digSlowdown effects, onGround, isInsideOfMaterial(water)

notes: The comment on player_str_vs_block (line 61) says the in-water /5 is not ported; harvest.c line 274 does apply it, so the comment is stale.
